card.name: Capitalized words in all-caps headings
card.fires_on: Words or word parts written in all capitals inside headings or titles, such as NEED, WARN, NEWS, ABOUT and ARG. Often in label section headings like WARNINGS or DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION.

modes.label: Label headings
modes.description: All-caps pieces in drug label section headings and statements.

modes.label: Caps in titles and news names
modes.description: All-caps words in web headlines or outlet names.
modes.example: ASIA<< NEWS>> NETWORK WE KNOW ASIA BETTER

modes.label: Split capitalized words
modes.description: A capitalized word cut into pieces, with the marked piece partway through.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION DOSAGE SHOULD BE INDIVIDUALIZED ACCORDING TO THE<< NEED>>S AND RESPONSE OF THE PATIENT.

card.plain: It lights up on words typed in all capitals in headings, like WARNINGS or NEWS.
